title: Hildreth & Associates CPA — Client intake & monthly close workflow automation
summary: Nashville/Brentwood small-business CPA firm offering bookkeeping, financial statements, cash flow management, and tax prep. Small advisory firms frequently lose billable hours to manual client document chasing and unstandardized onboarding follow-ups. Offering a lightweight automated intake and recurring close-reminder workflow delivers immediate ROI ahead of year-end close.

payload.painPoint: Manual client document chasing, fragmented onboarding, and slow follow-up ahead of tax/close deadlines
payload.recommendedAngle: 14-day automated client intake + missing-document follow-up pipeline pilot

title: Callison CPA — Contractor bookkeeping & payroll ops automation
summary: Chattanooga CPA firm serving small businesses and contractors with bookkeeping, payroll, financial statements, and assurance. Contractor-focused bookkeeping creates recurring bottlenecks around receipt collection, job-cost categorization, and monthly client check-ins. Loose Ends can pitch a structured intake and automated client status cadence before Q1 tax prep peaks.

payload.painPoint: Recurring receipt/payroll collection friction and manual monthly client follow-up
payload.recommendedAngle: Automated contractor document collection & monthly close status workflow

title: Hometown Plumbing, Electrical & HVAC — Missed-call & unclosed quote revenue recovery
summary: Knoxville multi-trade home-service operator offering 24/7 emergency plumbing, electrical, and same-day HVAC service with online scheduling prompts. High-volume multi-trade shops routinely leak revenue on after-hours inquiries and unclosed diagnostic quotes when dispatchers are overloaded. An automated missed-call text-back and 3-touch quote follow-up system recovers booked jobs immediately.

payload.painPoint: After-hours lead leakage, manual quote follow-up, and multi-trade dispatch handoff gaps
payload.recommendedAngle: Missed-call SMS recovery + automated 72-hour estimate follow-up sequence
